It includes quantities, status, location, lot/serial numbers, ownership, and other operational attributes. It is essential for tracking, receiving, putaway, picking, shipping, and inventory adjustments in WMS workflows. Users may refer to it as HU detail, unit-level inventory, or warehouse stock record.

pick_task_uom_summary.description: Technical query for This data represents the Unit of Measure (UOM) and quantity information for each pick task line in warehouse operations. The 't_pick_task_uom' table captures item-level picking details such as warehouse ID, lot number, cartonization batch, and planned vs actual quantities. It joins with 't_pick_detail' for task context, 't_item_master' for item reference, 't_wh' for warehouse data, 't_lot_master' for lot traceability, and 't_cartonization_batch' for carton grouping. This data supports cartonization validation, inventory accuracy, and analysis of pick efficiency in WMS workflows.

message_summary.description: Technical query for message tracking in warehouse operations. The 't_message' table captures messages sent to employees, including message content, priority, creation timestamps, read and response status. It joins with 't_emp_equipment' to validate employee and warehouse association, and with 't_wh' to ensure messages are linked to active warehouses. This data supports monitoring communication efficiency, tracking required responses, and maintaining operational accountability.

printer_summary.description: Technical query for printer management in warehouse operations. The 't_printer' table stores details of printers including type, network location, label templates, and printer status. It joins with 't_kitting_station' for kit printing assignments, 't_labels_being_printed' for ongoing label jobs, 't_manifest_station' for packing and shipping label assignments, and 't_return_station' for returns-related printing. This data ensures traceability, proper printer usage, and supports efficient warehouse labeling and cartonization processes.

whse_control_summary.description: Technical query for warehouse control settings. The 't_whse_control' table stores configuration and control parameters for each warehouse, including numeric and text-based control values. It is used to manage warehouse-level operational rules, limits, and settings that govern workflows, inventory handling, and process validations.

system_summary.description: Technical query for system master data. The 't_system' table stores information about each system instance including its identifier, name, go-live date, and contact information. This data is used to manage and reference systems within the WMS environment and support administrative, reporting, and communication workflows.

label_summary.description: Technical query for label tracking in warehouse operations. The 't_label' table captures information for each pick task label, including its unique ID, associated pick, batch, print sequence, and current status. It joins with related tables such as pick summaries, flash kit unpicks, pick confirmations, order UOM, pick details, and post picks to ensure end-to-end traceability of label creation, printing, and processing. This supports workflow validation, cartonization checks, and operational reporting in WMS.

menu_summary.description: Technical query for menu configuration in the WMS. The 't_menu' table stores the definitions of menus including menu ID, locale, area, level, name, sequence, display text, and associated process. It joins with 't_employee' to determine which users can access specific menu levels, with 't_locale' to filter active locales, with 't_lookup' for text descriptions, and with 't_menu_pick_method' for menu-specific pick method configurations. This supports dynamic menu rendering and user access control in warehouse applications.

country_summary.description: Technical query for country information in the system. The 't_country' table stores the unique country ID, country name, and country abbreviation. This table is standalone and does not have common columns with other tables. It supports country reference, localization, and reporting in WMS and related applications.

conditions.WHERE: region_id IS NOT NULL AND country_id IS NOT NULL

region_summary.description: Technical query for region information in the system. The 't_region' table stores the unique region ID, region name, associated country ID, and region abbreviation. This table is standalone and does not have common columns with other tables. It supports regional reference, localization, and reporting in WMS and related applications.

locale_date_format_summary.description: Technical query for locale-specific date formats in the WMS. The 't_locale_date_format' table stores the mapping of each locale to its corresponding date format. It joins with 't_employee' to apply locale-based settings for users, with 't_locale' to fetch locale information, with 't_lookup' for locale-specific text, and with 't_menu' to support menu localization. This is used for date display, reporting, and localization in warehouse applications.

pick_area_summary.description: Technical query for warehouse pick area configuration. The 't_pick_area' table stores details such as pick area code, warehouse ID, target pick percentage, work type, description, and container class. It joins with 't_employee' to map employee assignment, 't_item_uom' for item unit-of-measure constraints, 't_location' for location mapping, 't_pick_detail' for pick transactions, 't_printer' for label printing configurations, and various slot and recommendation tables for slotting and labor analysis. This supports warehouse operations, picking efficiency, and resource planning.

employee_prod_stds_summary.description: The 't_employee_prod_stds' table stores productivity standards for employees, including fixed and dynamic standards, along with the date of the dynamic standard. It joins with tables such as 't_emp_equipment' for assigned equipment, 't_exception_log' for transaction exceptions, 't_hu_detail' and snapshots for handling unit details, 't_isn_asn_header' and package details for ASN processing, 't_kit_complete' for kit completion records, 't_kship_shipment' and 't_mp_shipment' for shipment activities, 't_return_receipt' and 't_unknown_receipt' for returns and unidentified receipts, 't_tran_log' and 't_wms_transaction_log' for transaction logs, 't_tran_missing' for missing transactions, 't_wave_assignment' and 't_wave_master_audit' for wave activities, and 't_work_q' for work queue assignments. customer_summary.description: Technical query for customer information in the WMS system. full_floor_denial_summary.description: Technical query for full floor denial events in the system. invoice_detail_summary.description: Technical query for invoice line details in the system. The 't_invoice_detail' table stores information about each line in an invoice, including company, warehouse ID, invoice number, line number, item number, ordered quantity, invoiced quantity, backorder quantity, and price. This table is used for reporting, billing, and reconciliation in WMS and financial processes.
